entities.summary: Damian Clara is an Italian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for Brynäs IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL) while under contract to the Anaheim Ducks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 60th overall by the Anaheim Ducks in the second round of the 2023 NHL entry draft. He is the first Italian player to be selected in the NHL entry draft.
